title: Hazardous Materials Security Plans
archetype: hazardous materials security plans and rail routing
source_verification_depth: Complete Supporting Statement A plus package; underlying cited sources not all independently retrieved. Specific corroboration recorded separately.

score_rationale.reproducibility: Activity-specific company/site/route counts and times mostly reconstruct; some totals rounded.
score_rationale.provenance: 2019 wages and benefit share identified; population and timing assumptions are not current empirical estimates.
score_rationale.segmentation: Large/small new and existing firms, rail classes and route activities distinguished.
score_rationale.labor: Office-clerk rate for security planning needs occupational justification; benefit denominator method is explicit.
score_rationale.item13: Zero nonlabor cost repeated without implementation or systems boundary analysis.
score_rationale.item14: Zero asserted despite inspection activity, without allocation rationale.
score_rationale.item15: Rule removal has quantified responses and hours; directional typo in prose.
score_rationale.validation: Experienced estimates but no direct burden measurement or ranges.
score_rationale.consistency: One-hour update rounding and increase/decrease wording; main structure remains reproducible.

item14.rationale: No cost asserted; inspection allocation not explained

assumptions: Large firms have three sites; small firms one.
Rail classes I/II/III contain 7/32/100 carriers with distinct routes and hours.

reconstruction_issues: Office-clerk occupation for security-plan development is not justified against managerial/security/technical work.
Federal zero lacks explanation despite an explicit inspection activity.
Item 15 wording says increase where the documented removal is a decrease.
methods_worth_testing: Segment security implementation by sites, carrier class and activity; count assets separately from respondents.
